purpose: Calibrate the radial halo against a selection+autocorrelation null, replace centroid distance with edge distance, correct the angular analysis scope, and quantify readout circularity. Post-hoc relative to v4; declared before any v5 statistic was computed.

audit_findings_that_motivated_v5.cervilla_alignment: Cervilla loaders returned X subset with full-tissue coordinates; components() then indexed the first len(X) rows silently. Fixed 2026-09-30. Pool components 2859 -> 2900 (Cervilla 76 -> 117). Field anchors verified equal to pool components for all 53 Visium sections (2747 anchors).
audit_findings_that_motivated_v5.angular_scope: Only USZ carries a 'TUM' label value. HTAN values are carcinoma/carcinoma_border, STCRC values are tumor/tumor&stroma_*; the v4 angular run searched only for 'TUM', so sector 0 was arbitrary (+x) for 22/30 sections that were reported as 'labeled cohorts'. Any corridor claim is restricted to cohorts with a declared tumor-label map.
audit_findings_that_motivated_v5.readout_circularity: B_AXIS = 49/49 genes of the detection signature (definitionally circular). Hallmark overlaps with the 57-gene signature: allograft 10/200, IL2_STAT5 6/199, IFN_gamma 4/200, IL6 4/87, IFN_alpha 3/97, TNFA 1/200; 31 sets zero overlap.
audit_findings_that_motivated_v5.giant_components: hd-colon-16um has components of 4612/3304/1789 spots; centroid distance is meaningless there. Edge distance is used in v5 and HD is reported separately.
audit_findings_that_motivated_v5.metric_range: v4 'first available bin' was 200-300 for 52/53 Visium sections (pitch 100 everywhere), so the range concern is limited; the remaining issue is the absence of a null, not the range.

operator.distance: edge distance = distance to the nearest anchor spot; each spot is assigned to the component of its nearest anchor spot (Voronoi on the anchor mask); own-component ring at 1.3*pitch excluded
operator.bins: 0,100,...,1000 um; at least 5 spots per bin per anchor
operator.statistic: per anchor rel_drop = 1 - mean(bin 700-800)/mean(bin 200-300); require >=5 spots in both bins and near_mean >= 0.005; section statistic = median rel_drop over anchors; evaluable if >=8 anchors
operator.null: matched-autocorrelation surrogate fields. Per section: estimate sigma from observed lag-band correlations (bands 100-200, 200-400, 400-700, 700-1000; pairs sampled to <=200k) by fitting rho(d)=exp(-d^2/(4 sigma^2)) in log space using bands with rho>0.05; simulate iid white noise, smooth with a row-normalised Gaussian kernel exp(-d^2/(2 sigma^2)) truncated at 3 sigma, standardise; readout surrogate = rhoS*Zs + sqrt(1-rhoS^2)*Zr with rhoS = Spearman(observed detection, observed readout) and independent Zr smoothed with the readout's own sigma; quantile-map both surrogates to the observed marginals; anchors = top-10% of the surrogate detection field -> components(1.3*pitch, min_size=2) -> same edge-distance statistic. 200 draws.
operator.test: one-sided p = (1 + #{null median rel_drop >= observed median rel_drop}) / (N_draws + 1); halo signal claimed for a readout only if (a) >=50% of evaluable sections have p <= 0.05, (b) >=8 evaluable sections, (c) median observed rel_drop > median of per-section null medians
operator.claim_eligibility: only sets whose overlap with the 57-gene detection signature is < 20% of set size may support a biological claim; B_AXIS serves as a circular consistency reference
operator.angular: sector 0 is the direction to the nearest tumor spot only where a declared tumor-label map exists (USZ: label == TUM). Other cohorts are NOT_EVALUABLE for the corridor test. Corridor statistic = sector0 - mean(sector1,sector3) per radial band, median over anchors.

gates.P2_P3: unchanged; not opened by this round
gates.composition_control: NOT executed in v5; remains the open gap named in the v4 gate

v5_1_addendum.seen_before_declaration: one 2-section smoke run with 20 draws; no p-values, no full-panel statistics

changes.draw_threshold_fix: the 'too few draws' guard used a fixed 50 that a 20-draw smoke could never meet; now max(20, 0.5*N); this is a bug fix, not a threshold relaxation
changes.surrogate_diagnostics: each null row now records observed and median-null component counts plus the observed lag-band correlations used for the sigma fit
changes.conditioned_arm_added: PRIMARY arm: per-anchor near-minus-far contrast of the readout after regressing out deciles of the detection-field level (own spot, and 300 um-smoothed) plus a quadratic tissue trend; this removes the peak-selection effect without a covariance model. SURROGATE arm (v5.0) demoted to SECONDARY because a single-sigma Gaussian surrogate cannot reproduce the long-range component of real fields (smoke: fitted sigma 173 um predicts rho(700-1000)~0.00 while observed rho=0.29-0.59); the direction of that mismatch is conservative (null drops are inflated), so the surrogate arm is retained as a conservative reference, and component-count diagnostics are recorded to expose geometry mismatch.

v5_1_addendum.conditioned_arm_rule: per anchor delta = mean(residual, 200-300) - mean(residual, 700-800), >=5 spots per bin, >=8 anchors per section, section statistic = median delta; halo claimed for a readout iff both conditioned arms (own-field and 300 um-smoothed-field) give >=60% of evaluable sections with delta > 0 AND >=8 evaluable sections; only non-circular sets may carry a biological claim
v5_1_addendum.disagreement_rule: if the surrogate and conditioned arms disagree, the conditioned arm is reported as primary and the disagreement is reported explicitly; no set is called positive on the surrogate arm alone
